scope: Exact selected mathematical payloads and sources, independent review of publication-gate design; no new mathematical research or remote publication.

extraLeanFiles.meaning: Pinned build configuration and unchanged audit drivers; not additional advertised research modules.

presentationChanges: 252 Lean statement summaries, including the promoted FFD dependency, replace historical lexical-inventory text with a generic pointer to exact elaborated statements. This adds no mathematical assertion; all 265 full declaration payloads and source bytes remain unchanged.

findings.issue: The initial packager trusts RELEASE-FILES.json without binding its bytes to the approved review. Editing the allowlist could admit unreviewed files without changing already bound inputs.
findings.resolution: require_approved binds the exact RELEASE-FILES.json bytes through REVIEW.json.releaseFileManifestSha256. The packager uses a fixed approval-envelope list only, rejects envelope entries in the ordinary manifest, confines listed files to the package root, verifies every listed hash, and verifies every archived byte including the fixed envelope. No unrestricted unreviewed-file addition remains.

displayReview.method: Static generated HTML text and source UI/documentation review; no claim of a separate interactive browser session.

displayReview.findings: Conditional suppliers remain visible; paper review is not labelled kernel verification; liminf is not expanded to convergence; C50 identities are distinguished from unproved flux estimates; excluded entries have no result pages.
displayReview.uiReview: Landing and reading guide distinguish Lean verification, paper review, conditional results and abstract counterexamples. Search indexes theorem names and types, switches out of the featured-only view for active searches, and preserves access to a static index.
displayReview.docsReview: README, release notes, audit scope and hosting docs distinguish selected approval from original collection HOLD, standard Lean axioms, base replay and comment amendment, and absence of novelty certification.
displayReview.finalEnvelopeWork: Approval metadata and public indexing settings are intentionally not hashed by this independent mathematical/source receipt. Root must finalize those before packaging and bind all final website bytes in the approved release manifest.
displayReview.finalPresentationChecks: All 324 result pages now use the neutral selected-edition aside, with no stale original-collection HOLD banner. The C50 display-only spacing correction to conflate is present; its mathematical title, statement, hypotheses and proofText remain donor-identical.

approvalScope: Independent approval of this selected mathematical content, unchanged formal sources, gate design and static statement presentation. This is not a remote publishing action or approval of the excluded original claims. Final packaging must pass the scoped gate and exact file/archive hash checks after approval envelopes and public presentation settings are finalized.

finalGateRefresh.change: The gate now requires exact byte identity between repository and site/dist copies of audit/release/REVIEW.json and PUBLICATION-STATUS.json. Both paths are fixed; differences fail closed. Missing copies also prevent successful gate completion.
finalGateRefresh.scope: Only the bound gate script hash is refreshed. The catalogue is confirmed unchanged; prior mathematical/source/static-page review remains applicable.
